observations.text: Engine room garbage drums to be fitted with self-closing arrangements

positives: Inspector was a very well behaved gentleman
style: Calm and polite during the inspection
Started engine room rounds from the bottom platform and worked upwards
Tested alarms and equipment himself and had the ETO try out emergency steering
Asked management level questions on PMS
Spent about 15 minutes with the 3rd engineer and duty oiler on procedures and watch levels

questions.q: Management level questions on the planned maintenance system
Explain the dead ship recovery procedure
Explain the enclosed space entry procedure
What is the engine room watch level and what does the SMS say about it?
Explain the dead ship recovery procedure
Explain the enclosed space entry procedure
What is the engine room watch level and what does the SMS say about it?

checks.item: OWS 15 ppm alarm and 3-way valve operation
Main engine and auxiliary engine leak off alarms

tips: Keep engine room garbage drums fitted with self-closing lids
Be ready to explain dead ship recovery and enclosed space entry procedures to ratings as well as officers
summary: Engine room inspection by Capt Rohit Gullani of an oil major, described as a calm and well behaved gentleman. He took engine room rounds from the bottom platform, tested bilge, OWS, leak off and OMD alarms, had the ETO try emergency steering, and questioned the engineer on PMS and management level topics. He spent about 15 minutes with the 3rd engineer and duty oiler on dead ship recovery, enclosed space entry and watch levels, and raised one observation about engine room garbage drums needing self-closing arrangements. Port was not given.
